h1: Custom Embroidery Beanies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery beanies for your team or event. High-quality knit beanies with your logo embroidered. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a refined, dimensional look to custom beanies that screen printing or patches can't match. The stitch depth stands out on ribbed cuffs and pom-pom styles, making your logo legible even from a distance. For corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee uniforms, embroidered beanies convey quality and durability. Choose from cuff beanies, fleece-lined options, or pom-pom knits, all available with single- or multi-color embroidery on the front or side.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery beanies with logo on knit cuff, displayed on a table for bulk orders
